verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Financial Connections collecting and verifying bank accounts for ACH Direct Debit payments. Nothing in the pack documents variable recurring payments, standing consents, mandates, or a recurring or scheduled debit flow built on the connection. Account collection for a debit is not a recurring payment capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, recurring bank payments are supported — variable recurring payments, standing consents, or documented recurring debit flows built on the connection
